entities.name: Jessy
entities.description: A human-born girl with divine balance powers chosen by spirits, who was betrayed and sealed, and later hijacked Shina's body to seek the eradication of human civilization.
entities.quote: Then came Jessy/Asetra: a girl too powerful, too different. She hadn’t harmed anyone, but her existence terrified them.

entities.name: Azwar
entities.description: An inhabitant of the world on the other side of the barrier representing the truth of the losers.
entities.quote: Azwar and Azwain’s world is literally the truth on the other side of the barrier.

entities.name: Azwain
entities.description: An inhabitant of the world on the other side of the barrier whose saga is a rebellion against the lie.
entities.quote: Azwar and Azwain’s world is literally the truth on the other side of the barrier.

entities.name: Shina
entities.description: Her body was hijacked by Jessy because her physical form was strong enough to host her soul.
entities.quote: So she hijacked Shina’s body, which was strong enough to host her.

entities.name: Khalid
entities.description: Unsealed Jessy when her soul had no body left to return to.
entities.quote: When Khalid unsealed her, her soul had no body left to return to.

entities.name: Tamim
entities.description: Received the Cube from Jubayer, opened the portal linking universes, and delivered the Cube to his present-day counterpart.
entities.quote: Jubayer later realizes Jessy is the culprit, ambushes her, and steals the Cube — passing it to Tamim. Tamim opens the portal that links universes and delivers the Cube to his present-day counterpart.

entities.name: Marufa
entities.description: Present-day counterpart who receives the Cube and uses it to nullify Jessy's ancient magic and tear down the barriers.
entities.quote: Marufa uses it not to destroy, but to nullify all of Jessy’s ancient magic, which resets nothing but instead tears down the barrier — revealing the hidden realms.

entities.name: Nine Clans
entities.description: Clans founded from the myth of sealing Jessy, later divided by ability and ruling the human empire with oppression.
entities.quote: That became the founding myth of the Nine Clans. The Aftermath — Human Empire Clans divided by ability, basking in victory.

entities.name: Demon clan
entities.description: The first clan subjected to genocide when humans manipulated the narrative and convinced other clans to wipe them out entirely.
entities.quote: They convinced the other clans to wipe the demon clan out entirely. The first genocide.

timeline_events.title: The Beginning - Harmony
timeline_events.description: Humans were the weakest species yet teachable and equal, sharing gifts with elves, witches, beasts, and spirits.
timeline_events.quote: Humans were the weakest species, yet the most teachable. Elves, witches, beasts, spirits — they didn’t look down on them. They saw them as equals, even shared their gifts.

timeline_events.title: The Fall - Arrogance & Suspicion
timeline_events.description: Humans mastered all forms of magic and arts, believing themselves masters, and grew suspicious of the powerful girl Jessy.
timeline_events.quote: They climbed too fast, and started believing they weren’t students anymore but masters. Then came Jessy/Asetra: a girl too powerful, too different.
